info.name: BrainBuilder - Fee Module (Installments, Flexi Card, Split Payments, Teacher Gating)
info.description:
End-to-end test flow for the new fee module features: annual-fee installments, one-time fees, prepaid Flexi Card, split/partial payment allocation, per-program fee status, and teacher fee-visibility gating.

HOW TO USE:
1. Import this file into Postman (File > Import).
2. Open the collection's Variables tab and fill in `base_url` (default http://localhost:5006/api), `admin_email` and `admin_password` for an existing admin account on this server.
3. Run folder 0 then 1 through 9 in order, top to bottom (use the collection Runner, or just click through manually) — later requests depend on IDs captured by earlier ones via test scripts.
4. Folder 99 (Cleanup) removes every ZZPM-test-tagged record this run created. Run it last.

All test data created by this collection is tagged with the prefix `ZZPM` and a unique run_tag (timestamp) so repeat runs never collide and test records are easy to spot/delete manually if needed.

item.name: Create Class - Ordinary Hours-Based (legacy, no card)
item.description: This class deliberately does NOT set isPrepaidHoursCard, to prove the attendance-deduction routing falls through to the legacy global-pool path unchanged for classes that aren't prepaid cards. There's no HTTP request to directly test the attendance routing helper (it fires internally from the attendance module) — this class exists so you can mark this student's attendance via the existing /api/attendance endpoints afterward and confirm Student.consumedFlexiHours (not a Flexi Card ledger) is what moves.

item.name: Create Test Teacher
item.description: Created with canViewFeeInfo left at its default (false) — folder 8 verifies this teacher is blocked from fee routes until an admin explicitly grants the permission.

item.name: Delete Test Student
item.description: Note: this deletes the Student and Class documents, but does not cascade-delete the Installment/FlexiCardPurchase/Payment/StudentWallet/Invoice records this run created (the app has no cascade-delete for those, by design — they're a financial audit trail). If you want the database fully clean, remove those manually by studentId, or just leave them — they're clearly tagged (studentName starts with 'ZZPM') and harmless.
